No network requests exfiltrate data to remote hosts, no code is downloaded and executed from untrusted sources, and no obfuscated or encoded commands are present. The maintainer and upstream URLs are consistent, and all operations stay within the package's own application scope. No genuinely malicious or dangerous behavior is evident.
